race.comment: TRUSTY BANDIT (6) was only 1.5 lengths form the winner in city company at Doomben last time. Was a winner here the start prior. This suits and expected to go close. O'CALDINO (5) is on the quick back up after leading them up at Doomben in a Class 3 last Wednesday. Tough to beat back in this easier company. UCELLE (9) has not won for a long while. Last raced on August 2 when beaten 1.75 lengths into fifth at Sunshine Coast over 1600m. Suitably placed so anticipating a bold performance. RAINBOW GLITTER (8) won only try course and distance and will be charging home late. CHEERFUL CAT (4) also goes well here and has winning claims on best.
